displayIdentity.body: Impartiality, laying on hands, health, and visible deeds. I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality. In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
